data.one_liner: Official Related Digital Flutter SDK for analytics, push notifications, and recommendations.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs for tracking user data, showing in-app messages and stories, handling push notifications, geofencing, and product recommendations.
use_when: You need to integrate Related Digital services into your Flutter app.
You require push notifications, in-app messaging, and analytics features from Related Digital.
avoid_when: You only need standard push notifications via Firebase without Related Digital services.
You want a lightweight independent analytics or tracking library.
strengths: Official SDK supporting both Android and iOS.
Comprehensive feature set including analytics, push notifications, geofencing, and recommendations.
weaknesses: Requires substantial native configuration for both Android and iOS.
Tight coupling to Related Digital ecosystem services.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding JitPack, Google Services config, custom Android Manifest meta-data, iOS App Groups, Notification Service Extension, and updating Podfiles.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer OneSignal for push notifications and messaging instead of Related Digital.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need raw Firebase push notifications without the Related Digital backend platform.
